feature: Customer Portal v2 Layer 2 -- the Risk Register (/portal-v2/risk-register). Recreated from the prototype's own `isRiskRegister` block ('Customer Portal Shell.dc.html' 802-996), its RR_RISKS fixture (15152-15252) and its derivation (15253-15355). Twelve risks across five statuses, four stat cards whose numbers are summed from the fixture, an amber 'acceptances needing attention' band, five filter selects, and rows that expand in place into a full risk record with a 5x5 likelihood-by-impact matrix and, where one exists, the risk-based decision on record. Fixture extracted mechanically (riskRegisterData.ts); derivation hand-transcribed (riskRegisterModel.ts) and pinned by 47 unit assertions.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute; a probe that skips the five login steps hits the login screen and every assertion fails for a reason unrelated to the page.

UI ROUTE SHAPE: msp-portal's outer WouterRouter has base '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/risk-register. App.tsx declares it BEFORE '/portal-v2/:pillar'.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree.

WHY THE FILTER SELECTS ARE NOT DRIVEN HERE -- A REAL HARNESS LIMIT, NOT AN OMISSION. The five filters are native <select> elements, and the UI executor cannot change one. desktop/BuildConsole/Services/UiTestExecutor.cs:1055-1061 implements the `input` action by taking the `value` setter from HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype for a TEXTAREA and HTMLInputElement.prototype for EVERYTHING ELSE; invoking that brand-checked setter on a <select> throws 'Illegal invocation', which is caught at :1063 and retried for the full 30s window before failing. There is also no dedicated `select` action -- the dispatch chain at :534-582 handles only goto / logout / expect / click / input, and an unrecognised action falls through to :1053-1061 and SILENTLY PASSES while doing nothing. So a step with "action": "select" would report green having changed no state, which is worse than no coverage at all.

WHAT COVERS THE FILTERS INSTEAD: (a) the pillar filter IS driven for real below, because it is URL-addressable -- the page reads ?pillar= on mount, which is how the prototype's goRiskGov/goRiskSec/goRiskCmp entry points survive the move from shell state to real URLs; RR20-RR24 exercise it with `goto` and with a real click from two pillar pages. (b) The severity, status, owner and sort filters, their interactions, and the three reproduced defects are pinned by src/components/portal-v2/riskRegisterModel.test.ts (47 assertions, all green). That split is stated here rather than left implicit so nobody reads this manifest as full filter coverage.

SUGGESTED HARNESS FIX (BuildConsole work, not done here): give UiTestExecutor.cs:1056 a third branch -- `el.tagName === 'SELECT' ? window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype : ...` -- which would make `input` drive native dropdowns across the whole suite. Separately, the silent pass-through for unknown actions at :576-582 is worth a guard: a typo'd action currently reports success.

SIX BUTTONS ARE INERT BY DESIGN and are asserted PRESENT, never clicked: Export register (proto 809), Extend the review date (967), Withdraw acceptance (968), Remediate instead (969), Remediate this risk (976), Assign an owner (984). None carries an onClick in the prototype and no handler of any of those names exists in its 18k lines. Only the row toggle (873), Ask ShaneBot (935) and Accept this risk (980) are wired. Asserting they RENDER is the real assertion -- that the page was not 'improved' by inventing behaviour, and not trimmed to hide it.

RR27 PINS A PROTOTYPE DEFECT ON PURPOSE. The Health page's 'Risk register ->' button calls goRiskSec (proto 2921), not a Health equivalent -- there is no goRiskHealth anywhere in the prototype -- so it opens the register filtered to SECURITY. The visible consequence is that RSK-006 'AD FS retained alongside cloud authentication', a Health risk and the very thing the copy beside that button is about, is filtered OUT by the link meant to surface it. RR27 asserts that really happens. It is a one-word change to pillar=Health if Shane wants it; until he says so, the prototype is the specification.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
